```{r}
library(fda)
```

***1. Bases de Fourier***

*1.1 Tracé des fonctions de bases*

```{r}
# 1.(b)
fourier <- create.fourier.basis(c(0,1), 9)
plot(fourier)
```

```{r}
# 2.
(eval1 <- getbasismatrix(seq(0, 1, .01), fourier, 1))
oldpar <- par(no.readonly=TRUE)
matplot(eval1, type="l")
```

```{r}
# 3.
(eval2 <- eval.basis(seq(0, 1, .01), fourier))
matplot(eval2, type="l")
```

*1.2 Simuler des fonctions aléatoires*

```{r}
coeff = runif(9, -1, 1)
ft <- apply(t(coeff*t(eval2)), 1, sum)
ft
plot(ft, type="l")
```
